listing.name: ScribbleFarer
listing.summary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like version of Starfarer with custom ships, weapons, and missions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like version of Starfarer with custom ships, weapons, and missions.

description: Adds a cartoony, kid-like version of Starfarer with custom ships, weapons, and missions. Features a Vandalian faction with a Mothership and Alien Carrier, along with rebalanced gameplay and custom sprites. Includes a progress report and to-do list for future content.
